title: FavStash Short-Form SFX Pack
guidance: Choose a sound for a visible event and audition it against speech. Prefer curated sounds or the creator's established library; ordinary caption changes stay silent.

sounds.title: Clean Ding
sounds.recommendedUse: A positive result or satisfying completion; use sparingly.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Sub Impact
sounds.recommendedUse: One important claim, number, or final reveal—not every cut.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Typing Tick
sounds.recommendedUse: Occasional typed-character accents; never repeat on every letter for long copy.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Sparkle
sounds.recommendedUse: A delightful payoff or premium highlight; keep below the voice.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Camera Shutter
sounds.recommendedUse: A substantial camera or layout change.
sounds.provenance: Maintainer-supplied recording; included at the maintainer's request.

sounds.title: Light Shutter
sounds.recommendedUse: A smaller framing or take change.
sounds.provenance: Maintainer-supplied recording; included at the maintainer's request.

sounds.title: UI Pop
sounds.recommendedUse: An element visibly arrives; not every caption.
sounds.provenance: Maintainer-supplied recording; included at the maintainer's request.

sounds.title: UI Click
sounds.recommendedUse: A visible click, selection or editing action.
sounds.provenance: Maintainer-supplied recording; included at the maintainer's request.

sounds.title: Zoom Swish
sounds.recommendedUse: A motivated zoom; align its rise with travel.
sounds.provenance: Maintainer-supplied recording; included at the maintainer's request.

sounds.title: Hook Impact
sounds.recommendedUse: The payoff of a reveal, below speech.
sounds.provenance: Maintainer-supplied recording; included at the maintainer's request.

sounds.title: Metallic Riser
sounds.recommendedUse: Build anticipation and end at the reveal.
sounds.provenance: Maintainer-supplied recording; included at the maintainer's request.
